newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-SAMPRAS HOT FAVOURITE FOR WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS HOT FAVOURITE FOR WIMBLEDON.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras was installed on Monday as a short-priced favourite to win his fourth Wimbledon men's title in five years.
The American was quoted at 6-4 by bookmakers Ladbrokes, with the list of potential challengers headed by Boris Becker at 6-1.
The odds on a British champion have been cut to 20-1 following the recent form of Canadian-born Greg Rusedski.
"With Rusedski playing the best tennis of his life and Tim Henman returning to Wimbledon, the prospect of a British men's champion is not the joke it once was," a Ladbroke's spokesman said.
